title: Living Things
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Living Things Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Living things have features and behaviours that help them survive: classifying living and non-living things, names of local plants and animals, structural features, and behavioural adaptations such as dormancy, camouflage and migration. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 1, Biology)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets (BC): living or non-living, what living things do, animal groups and body parts, and how animals survive. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Living things grow and have young.
key_sub: Body parts and behaviours help animals survive.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things grow, eat, breathe and make young.

  • A rock is not living; a tree is living.
  • Body parts like claws or fins help animals live.
  • Some animals hide by blending in (camouflage).
Example

Is a cloud living?

Does it eat, grow and have young?

Answer: no

Example

Why is a polar bear white?

Think about snow.

Answer: it blends in with the snow

Common mistakes

  • Thinking anything that moves is living (a car moves but is not living).
  • Thinking plants are not living.
